components.name: Quick Exit Button

components.name: Composer Field

components.name: Message Tiles
components.description: The conversation column: assistant tiles in tile white with a joint-line border, her tiles in cobalt, 12px joints, 2px corners, settle motion on arrival.
components.html:
1. Escreva sua pergunta com suas palavras. Respondo de forma simples.

    A conversa some quando você toca em Sair ou fecha o app.

  2. Tenho direito a algum auxílio?
components.css: .ds-mensagens { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background: var(--chao, #f4f6f9); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-msg { max-width: 88%; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 2px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-msg p { margin: 0; } .ds-msg p + p { margin-top: 8px; } .ds-msg-assistente { align-self: flex-start; background: var(--azulejo, #ffffff); color: var(--tinta, #142036); border: 1px solid var(--linha, #d5dce8); } .ds-msg-usuaria { align-self: flex-end; background: var(--cobalto, #1e4597); color: var(--sobre-cobalto, #ffffff); } .ds-nota { color: var(--tinta-suave, #4a5670); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-nova { animation: ds-assentar 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-assentar { from { transform: translateY(6px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nova { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The app is a single conversation column laid out like a wall of Athos Bulcão tiles in a Brasília building: chalk-white tiles on a cool ground, deep cobalt as the one house colour, ink-blue text, square corners. It must read as an ordinary notes utility to anyone glancing at the phone, so the system is quiet, flat, and plain; its only ornament is one tile module (a square holding a quarter circle), used in the 12px strip under the header and in the app icon. It deliberately refuses the help-hotline category look: grey chat, a purple "support" accent, soft rounded bubbles.

Density is calm and mobile-first: one 40rem column, generous 17px body text, 44 to 48px touch targets, and a composer pinned above the safe area. Light and dark schemes are both first-class and switch only through `prefers-color-scheme`; every role token is remapped on `:root`, nothing is restyled per component except the tile strip's SVG.

Motion is a single gesture: a new message settles into the column with a short rise, nothing else animates.
keyCharacteristics: One house colour (cobalt) marking exactly three things: the header band, her messages, the send action.
Square-cornered tiles (2px) separated by 12px joints, flat, no shadows.
One ornament: the quarter-circle tile module, never anywhere else.
System sans only; no web fonts.
States and errors stay inside the chalk/cobalt/ink palette.

rules.name: The One House Colour Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks only the header band, her messages, and the send action (plus focus and selection). Adding cobalt to a fourth kind of element dilutes the only signal the screen has.

rules.name: The Palette-Bound State Rule
rules.body: Errors and offline states are drawn with tile white, ink, and a 1px cobalt rule; never red, amber, or any hue outside the palette. Alarm colours would announce the app to an onlooker. The copy carries the meaning; the rule is a secondary cue.

rules.name: The Flat Ramp Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and colour (ink vs. soft ink), not size jumps; the ramp spans only 0.9375rem to 1.125rem. Never add uppercase tracking labels or eyebrow text above content.

rules.name: The Shared Edge Rule
rules.body: Anything that spans the full width (bands, bars, notices) aligns its content to the 40rem column, never to the viewport edge.

rules.name: The Laid Tile Rule
rules.body: Surfaces lie flat on the wall. Distinguish them with fill and a 1px rule, never with shadow, blur, or translucency.

rules.name: The One Module Rule
rules.body: The quarter-circle tile is the only ornament, and it lives only in the header strip and the icon. Curves belong to the module; containers stay square. The strip is never smaller than 12px tall: the module stops reading below that.

dos: **Do** keep cobalt to the header band, her messages, and the send action, plus focus and selection (The One House Colour Rule).
**Do** draw every error and system notice with tile white, ink, and a 1px cobalt rule, and let the plain pt-BR copy carry the meaning.
**Do** keep all corners at 2px and all surfaces flat, separated by 1px rules.
**Do** align full-width bands to the 40rem column through the shared side inset and add safe-area insets to sticky bars.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px minimum (Sair) and 48px for the send button and input.
**Do** keep the quick-exit "Sair" white-on-cobalt in the header on every screen, in both schemes.
**Do** remap colours only through the `:root` tokens for dark mode.
donts: **Don't** use red, amber, or any hue outside chalk, cobalt, and ink for errors, warnings, or offline states.
**Don't** add shadows, blur, gradients, or translucency.
**Don't** use the quarter-circle module anywhere except the header strip and the app icon, and never render the strip below 12px.
**Don't** round containers beyond 2px or use soft pill bubbles; curves belong only to the tile module.
**Don't** add eyebrow or kicker labels, glyph-character icons, or icon fonts; icons are inline SVG.
**Don't** put "Rede Lilás", or anything that mentions violence, women, or reporting, in any visible name, title, or icon.
